rule: Temporary fixing projects retain original roots; imported modules remain imports so rootDir and declaration-backed views keep their original meaning.
quote: Type checkers work through `.d.vibe.ts` (VIP-27), and linters, Knip, bundlers and test runners each read `.vibe`. Every tool is tested against the dogfood repositories.
observed: An imported Vibe dependency promoted to a root can expose its generated .vibe.throwing.ts view outside rootDir and produce TS6059.
